messages:
Jordan (support): Customer on Private (VPC) installer reports "connection reset" and TLS verify failures during model shard fetches. Asking for exact egress allowlist and quick repro steps.

Matt (infra): Can you paste the installer log snippet and run a quick openssl/dig from the failing host?

Jordan (support): Log:

```
[2026-07-02T09:12:01Z] downloading https://shards-us.redwood-inference.com/shard-abc
curl: (56) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer
openssl s_client -connect shards-us.redwood-inference.com:443 -servername shards-us.redwood-inference.com
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=2 C = US, O = Corp, CN = Corp TLS Intercept CA
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
subject=/CN=corp-intercept.local
issuer=/CN=Corp TLS Intercept CA
---
no peer certificate available
```

Jordan (support): Dig shows internal IP:

```
$ dig +short shards-us.redwood-inference.com
10.0.200.45
```

Sinha (onprem): That looks like split-horizon DNS + TLS interception. Two paths: (1) prefer SNI passthrough/bypass so traffic reaches our CDN and you get our certs, or (2) inject our CA into the proxy truststore. For allowlist we prefer SNI allowlisting by FQDN.

Liz (engineer): Minimal outbound FQDNs we require (TCP 443 unless noted):
- shards-us.redwood-inference.com
- registry-us.redwood-inference.com
- packages.redwood-inference.com
- auth.redwood-inference.com
- telemetry.redwood-inference.com (optional)
- pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org
- ghcr.io / docker.io if pulling containers
- objects.storage.redwood-inference.net (S3/GCS endpoints)

Also allow HTTP (80) to ocsp and crl endpoints for certificate revocation checks: ocsp.digicert.com, ocsp.int-x3.letsencrypt.org

Matt (infra): Note: CDNs have dynamic IPs. Please prefer SNI/FQDN exemptions. If firewall rules must be IP-based we can share current edge IP ranges on request but they'll change.

Jordan (support): Customer asked if telemetry is mandatory for install.

Liz (engineer): Not mandatory. If blocked the installer will continue but we won't receive health pings. Auth and model artifact endpoints must be reachable.

Matt (infra): Quick checks for them to run and paste back:
1) curl -vI https://shards-us.redwood-inference.com
2) openssl s_client -connect shards-us.redwood-inference.com:443 -servername shards-us.redwood-inference.com -showcerts
3) curl -vI --resolve shards-us.redwood-inference.com:443:198.51.100.210 https://shards-us.redwood-inference.com/health

If --resolve returns our cert CN (*.redwood-inference.com) but normal DNS returns corp cert, it's DNS/egress interception.

Jordan (support): I'll forward the FQDN list and the checks. If the proxy team wants IPs we can request current CDN edges but recommend SNI passthrough.

deploy-bot: private-installer:run 1796654321 -> queued

Sinha (onprem): Addendum for KB: include sample /etc/hosts temporary test to point to public IPs, and note to restore DNS after tests. Also show how to add CA into Debian/Ubuntu ca-certificates.

Jordan (support): Sending now. Will update thread when customer confirms bypass or CA injection applied.
